response.original_title: Job Wanted - award winning 48-hour short film
response.overview: A teenager struggles to find his first job. This film was made as part of the Idaho Fall 48. We were given a prompt including: genre: coming of age/teen comedy character: librarian prop: picture frame line of dialogue: "Never start a land war in Asia" In 48 hours, we had to write, film, and edit a short film incorporating all parts of that prompt. This was our final product.
response.title: Job Wanted - award winning 48-hour short film
